```
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    node_dict = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    parent = {n["id"]: n["parent"] for n in nodes}
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    # Precompute ancestors for all nodes
    ancestors = {}
    def get_ancestors(node_id):
        if node_id in ancestors:
            return ancestors[node_id]
        path = []
        cur = node_id
        while cur is not None:
            path.append(cur)
            cur = parent.get(cur)
        path.reverse()
        ancestors[node_id] = path
        return path
    # Initially retain all non-removable nodes
    retained = {n["id"] for n in nodes if not n["removable"]}
    # Function to check covered symbols
    def covered_symbols():
        return {node_dict[nid]["symbol"] for nid in retained}
    unmet = required_symbols - covered_symbols()
    while unmet:
        best_id = None
        best_new = float('inf')
        for sym in unmet:
            candidates = [nid for nid, n in node_dict.items() if n["symbol"] == sym and nid not in retained]
            for nid in candidates:
                path = get_ancestors(nid)
                new_count = sum(1 for a in path if a not in retained)
                if new_count < best_new:
                    best_new = new_count
                    best_id = nid
        # Add path of best_id
        path = get_ancestors(best_id)
        for nid in path:
            retained.add(nid)
        unmet = required_symbols - covered_symbols()
    retained_node_ids = list(retained)
    removed_node_ids = [n["id"] for n in nodes if n["id"] not in retained]
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_node_ids, "retained_node_ids": retained_node_ids}
```
